error_codes.hint: The clipboard opened but its memory object was rejected (allocation/lock/SetClipboardData); free memory or retry the copy

socket() returned an error (fd limit / protocol unsupported); close unused sockets and retry
The port is taken or privileges are missing; pass port 0 to let the OS pick an ephemeral port

error_codes.hint: setsockopt(SO_RCVTIMEO/SO_SNDTIMEO) failed; do not continue into an unbounded wait, close and reopen the socket
select() returned an error (fd set invalid or interrupted); re-check the running flag before retrying
send() returned <= 0 mid-write (peer closed or timeout); the byte stream is no longer reliable
recv() returned an error (peer reset or socket closed)
SO_RCVTIMEO elapsed before any byte arrived; bytes already received may still be parseable, treat this as 'no more data now'
